lines.text: Struggling with emails in foreign languages?
One click with MailMind. Understands 14 languages and crafts a culturally perfect reply.
Detects your industry. Compare 3 replies. Insert straight into Gmail. No more email anxiety.
Start free at mailmind dot yongcha dot app.
외국어 이메일, 어떻게 답장하고 있어요?
MailMind 클릭 한 번. 14개 언어를 이해하고, 그 나라 문화까지 반영한 완벽한 답장이 완성됩니다.
업종 자동 감지, 3가지 답변 비교, Gmail에 바로 삽입. 이제 외국어 이메일이 두렵지 않습니다.
mailmind.yongcha.app 에서 무료로 시작하세요.
外国語のメール、どう返信してますか？
MailMindをクリックするだけ。14言語を理解し、文化まで反映した完璧な返信が完成します。
業種を自動検出。3パターンを比較してGmailに直接挿入。もう外国語メールは怖くない。
mailmind.yongcha.app で無料スタート。
How much time do you spend on emails in foreign languages every day?
Reading them carefully. Translating. Trying to sound professional. Then rewriting again.
MailMind is a Chrome extension that lives inside Gmail and changes all of that.
Open any email — in English, Japanese, Chinese, or any of 14 supported languages.
Click MailMind. It reads the entire email thread in seconds.
It detects your industry — IT, finance, legal — and applies the right terminology automatically.
It understands cultural context, so your reply sounds natural, not just translated.
Three reply options appear. Compare them. Choose the best one. Or let Smart Reply decide.
Click Insert — and your reply lands in Gmail's compose window, ready to send.
MailMind also summarizes long threads so you always know the context.
And it flags tasks — deadlines, follow-ups, meetings — so nothing slips through.
Set up your signature and templates once. MailMind remembers them every time.
Pro plan: 300 replies per month. 14 languages. Zero switching between apps.
Stop letting language be a barrier to your business.
Start free at mailmind dot yongcha dot app.
